--a son of पृथु and Arcis. When he ascend- ed the throne, he divided the kingdom among his brothers. He earned the surname of अन्तर्धान having obtained from Indra the power of going about incognito. Through his queen शिखण्डिनी he had three sons. Father of हविर्धान through another wife नभस्वती. Thinking that king's [page३-222+ २३] duties involved cruelty, he launched on a prolonged sacrifice by setting his mind on आत्मन्। भा. IV. १९. १८; २२. ५४; २
